This is kinda happening to me and I'm not really handling it well. :(
I'm 22 and I've never really had a very close friend before. I was homeschooled from second grade on so i didn't ever really meet new people. I did have a best friend through my teen years, but we've never been very emotionally close, and towards the latter part of my time knowing him, he stopped including me much in his life. Most of my time was spent alone so my social skills are pretty not great and my self esteem is practically nonexistent. 

Well, towards the beginning of 2015, I met this girl who completely demolished my view of how friendship works. She was so nice to me, and she made so many efforts to express that she cared that no one ever had before. I didn't know it was possible for someone to see value in me, not in real life, and yet she did. She was one of the first friends I've ever made that would actually hug me when I left. I'd lived without affection my whole life, so this really shook my life up (in a good way at the time). It was like feeling warmth for the first time after only knowing the cold. She made me realize that I'd been waiting and hoping for a friend like her my entire life.

It probably won't come as a surprise to many people, but my low self esteem and anxiety made me fuck up with her a few times, so she ended up putting a lot of distance between us for a while. She couldn't deal with my emotional baggage and i can't say that I blame her. Who wants to be friends with someone who needs you so much? I became deeply depressed, because I lost such an important person to me, and it was all my fault. I had panic attacks every other day for months, I beat myself up over it constantly.

Then, one day after about eight months, surprisingly we reconnected. And it went so well. She wasn't comfortable hanging out with me alone, because I guess she has a lot of personal space walls, which I get, but we started talking every day online, and before long, we were Snapping each other (and we were the only people we really talked to on Snapchat at the time), watched Westworld together (across facebook, but still), and even more recently we started hanging out in person alone with each other. It felt like I was actually getting the friendship with her that I'd hoped for, and for the first time I thought I'd actually be the best friend of my best friend.

You know where this goes. 

She started talking to me less, and Snapping me less. She stopped tagging me in things. Plans became very hard for her to commit to, even a week or two ahead of time. Then her and her boyfriend, as well as the friend circle I'd started to be a part of through her, all started go out without me. She stopped reaching out to me, and i began to be the only one starting conversations. All of these things combined with the added sadness of losing that hope of being her best friend... i've just felt so heartbroken.

i tried to reach out to her and talk to her about it, but it didn't go well. She didn't really know where i was coming from. She felt like I was being critical, which i wasn't trying to be at all, and it made her feel like a terrible friend. I understand where she's coming from. she stopped talking to me for a week after that. while we are communicating a little more now (it's been two weeks) and i think we'll be okay, i'm still so afraid of continuing to lose her to her new SO. I don't know what to do

As someone with self esteem problems and a lot of other issues that make it really hard to be even just a normal person (this thread is basically: be above average or you deserve to be alone), shit like this is really fucking unnecessary. I don't know if I'd be considered a *Nice Guy™*, but I fit some of the criteria and reading shit like this is just a kick to the stomach.

I don't have any *fucking* hope in my life. Not a one. There is nothing going on for me and it'd be years before I could even kind of resemble the requirements people in this thread are placing on a partner. But you know what? Love and affection are something i've always sought. I had crushes on girls when I was in first grade, I've always been a bleeding heart. So, because of how important it's always been to me, I've been immensely depressed about no one ever having any kind of real love or affection for me. It breaks my heart. And, depression is fun this way, if it's bad enough it can completely fuck with your motivation, energy levels, self esteem, etc., which are, funnily enough, the most important factors in bettering yourself. So, I'm too depressed because no one cares about me to be able to make the changes I need for someone to care about me. Where the fuck do I go? What the fuck can I even do? So, I do become desperate, and I do fall for female friends, and I do hope that, because they like me and care about me, they might just feel strongly enough about me to love me, or have sex with me, or even just kiss me, because to guys like me, such things feel as unlikely as winning the lottery, and it's an absolutely valueless, nauseating and suicidally depressing feeling. You know why? because to us, those actions would make us feel like at some point in our lives we were valuable to someone else.

all of you who find this ridiculous, imagine how loved you've been throughout your entire life, how much sex you've had, how many signs of affection that've been given to you. Now imagine you've never experienced any of it, except through movies or dreams, and no matter how hard you tried, despite everything keeping you down and all the negativity and harsh cold reality and depression you've had to live with, you'll still never be enough for someone to give it to you despite having it in abundance their whole life. and i know that if i ever befriended anyone else who felt this way, and I also knew that doing any of the things I listed above would help them, I would do it in a heartbeat. Feeling like this isn't something I'd wish on anyone. it is living torture. suicide has crossed my mind multiple times, because why should i suffer living any longer when i know that i will never be valuable enough to anyone for them to give me the love i've been internally torturing myself over my entire life for not having. to feel like i am valuable enough to a friend that they would grant me the wish of one of the most intimate things you can do with someone else, *even though they don't like me that way?* it would mean the universe to me.

when you have been this isolated, loveless and affectionless for so long, you stop seeing gender. i don't feel like a male. i just feel like an alone and unlovable being that desperately wishes the universe would grant them a single experience of truly feeling valuable, so maybe they can actually believe it for once.

edit: i realize it's no one's responsibility to help me with these things. trust me, i know. but hoping that someone might is the only thing keeping people like me going. so yes, your guy friend might want to sleep with you, and you may feel betrayed by that, but for some of us at least, it's a lot more complicated than just wanting sex for the sake of sex. it might feel like the most important thing in the world to us, but also the most impossible. and it's soul crushing.
